messages.subject: Help with R class next week
parts:
Hi druggies,

I am teaching an R "bootcamp" next week (this week? Sept. 14-18) and would like to have a few more people in the room who can help students when they get stuck. The class is designed for novices, so you needn't be an expert. Mornings (9-12) will be lecture and short exercises; afternoons (1-4) will be independent work. You are welcome to help whenever and however much you want, but I could especially use a few more people for the afternoons, Monday afternoon most of all.

Let me know -- off-list, don't hit reply :) -- if you are interested or have any questions.

Cheers,

Michael
